BiblicalUsage: The virtuous woman looks well to the ways of her household and eats not the bread of idleness, and the word is the same idleness the proverbs warn against all through. It appears only here.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the worthy woman's strength is in her watching, because a household stands on the work no one sees.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
